notes: C3 has no qualifying primary because the command is carried by FIFO transaction buffers and used only as an operation selector, while the bus request field and sequencing state are barred by the supplied rules.
The fixed C4 rubric treats the transmitted payload as confidential even though the RTL intentionally exposes its waveform on onewire_o.

points.reason: A bus write condition assigns ctrl.enable, so an attacker can change the setting or write zero to disable operation.
The enable-dependent clear logic can clear the transmit or receive FIFO and prevent queued transfers.
The enable-dependent transmit-FIFO clear can discard queued work and prevent operation.
The enable condition resets the clock counter and suppresses tick generation when disabled.
The enable participates in the interrupt indication, so changing it can suppress service signaling.
The engine copies ctrl.enable into its state MSB, allowing the setting to disable the serial operation.
This point only forwards the stored enable value to an output and does not itself modify or block the setting.
Bus writes load the prescaler and divider registers, allowing timing configuration to be changed or set to a value that prevents useful ticks.
The stored settings select the clock source and terminal count, so an unsuitable selection or divider can stop tick generation.
The bus data field supplies the command portion of the transmit FIFO word.
The FIFO instance receives the command word and its clear input can discard queued commands.
The returned command selects the serial operation, including the no-operation path.
The bus write supplies the eight-bit payload to the transmit FIFO.
The FIFO buffers the payload, and its clear input can discard it before transmission.
The engine loads and shifts the payload into serial.sreg, where state and timing controls determine whether it is transmitted.
The payload-dependent drive level crosses the boundary on onewire_o and can be changed by the serial drive assignments.
The input is synchronized, sampled and shifted into the received result, so changing the input path changes the received byte.
This point only carries the already formed receive word into the FIFO.
The FIFO stores and returns received data, while its write and clear paths can alter or discard the stored word.
The receive clear signal can discard received data before software reads it.
The receive-read control determines when the FIFO word is consumed and can withhold the expected read transfer.
The receive word is returned in bus_rsp_o.data, and the bus read conditions determine whether software receives it.
The presence bit is sampled from the one-wire response and is only produced when the reset sequence reaches its sampling and completion points.
This point only carries the already computed presence bit into the receive FIFO.
The receive FIFO stores the presence-bearing word and can be written or cleared before readback.
Clearing the receive FIFO can prevent the presence result from becoming available.
The bus read conditions control whether the presence-bearing receive word is returned.
The input level is copied into the sampling pipeline, so changing onewire_i can change the sensed value.

points.reason: The sampled wire level is inserted into the status readback and can therefore produce an incorrect software-visible sense value.
The interrupt output is computed from enable, transmit availability and busy state, so those controls can create or suppress the service indication.
A control write can change ctrl.enable, which directly participates in the interrupt condition.
The FIFO availability output participates in irq_o, and changing queue state can create or suppress the service indication.
The derived busy state is an input to irq_o, so changing it changes whether an interrupt is asserted.
